intent: Block semantic reduction when the Context Envelope binding, Problem Frame, entry gate, authority snapshot, freshness, claim ceiling, or selected Context Item digests do not agree exactly.

required_conditions: the context binding record digest verifies
the binding names the exact bound frame digest
the frame and binding name the same context epoch and envelope
the entry gate names the exact frame and context binding
the authority snapshot digest agrees with the entry gate
selected Context Item digests, freshness, and claim ceiling agree
legacy unbound receipt bytes remain unchanged
